left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Treatment-naïve  [OR] or - pegIFN  [OR]  [OR] (or IFN), and/or Ribavirin  [OR] (RBV) and/or sofosbuvir (PRS) [AND]  experienced with confirmed CHC, genotypes 1, [OR]  2, [OR]  3, [OR]  4, [OR]  5, [OR]  or 6, with or without compensated cirrhosis, receiving combination therapy with the all oral GLE/ [OR] PIB regimen according to standard of care, international guidelines and in line with the current local label

right.raw_text: -  May be enrolled up to 4 weeks after treatment initiation

left.raw_text: -  Patients must voluntarily sign and date Informed Consent Form prior to inclusion into the study
-  Patient must not be participating or intending to participate in a concurrent interventional therapeutic trial
